sessions.title: The result she did not send
sessions.focus: Priya describes the failed exam and delayed disclosure.
sessions.possible_movement: She notices that secrecy increased the meaning of the result.
sessions.carry_forward: Choose one safe person to consider telling.

sessions.title: When the body becomes evidence
sessions.focus: They reconstruct a panic-like episode and the conclusions attached to each sensation.
sessions.possible_movement: Priya distinguishes a sensation from a prediction while retaining uncertainty.

sessions.title: The perfect study day
sessions.focus: Her elaborate plan repeatedly collapses before noon.
sessions.possible_movement: They design a deliberately modest twenty-minute study experiment.
sessions.carry_forward: Complete three short blocks, not a marathon.

sessions.title: An imperfect drawing
sessions.focus: Priya brings a rough design exercise she would normally hide.
sessions.possible_movement: She allows it to remain unfinished while discussing what she learned.
sessions.carry_forward: Share one draft with a trusted colleague.

sessions.title: Telling her cousin
sessions.focus: Disclosure brings warmth and an unwanted suggestion to 'just relax.'
sessions.possible_movement: Priya practices asking for listening rather than advice.

sessions.title: The practice test spike
sessions.focus: A low score triggers racing thoughts and a canceled weekend.
sessions.possible_movement: She returns to the plan the next day without compensatory overwork.

sessions.title: Exam week without guarantees
sessions.focus: They identify sleep, food, travel, and coping plans that do not depend on feeling calm.
sessions.possible_movement: Priya accepts that anxiety can accompany competent action.

sessions.title: After the attempt
sessions.focus: The final session processes the exam experience without requiring the result.
sessions.possible_movement: Priya defines progress by how she responded before, during, and after uncertainty.
sessions.carry_forward: Continue care based on need, not outcome.
